entry_points.name: decodeUnit
entry_points.output: Option (UTF16 units × exact remaining scalar codes)
entry_points.scope: One raw scalar or JSON escape; malformed, quote and unescaped control inputs fail.

entry_points.name: decodeQuoted
entry_points.output: Option (UTF16 units × exact remaining scalar codes)
entry_points.scope: One complete quoted prefix; exact closing boundary.

entry_points.name: decodeString
entry_points.scope: One complete string token; trailing input fails.

entry_points.name: decodeStringBytes
entry_points.scope: Complete shortest-form UTF-8 input and one complete string token.

retained_representation.escaped_unpaired_surrogate: Retain the UTF-16 unit in raw syntax; scalar-AST conversion still requires a separate profile outcome.
retained_representation.supplementary_scalar: Two UTF-16 units; escaped pair and raw scalar have the same decoded units.
retained_representation.original_spelling: Input remains unchanged; exact prefix meaning binds consumed spelling. No separate returned lexeme field.
retained_representation.object_key_alias: Decoded units determine future duplicate-key qualification; this API does not parse objects.

internal_fuel: input.length + 1; sufficient for all finite meaningful content by theorem
